transcript.text: I'd like to start. I reviewed the county health guidance for the pantry this week, and there are some important requirements we need to incorporate into our draft plan. The guidance specifies that refrigerated food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, with the temperature logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open. It also requires sealed packages to display allergen labels. I have the printed guidance in my health-office binder, but I haven't yet added these details to the pantry draft plan.

transcript.text: I'd like to share the results of the family outreach I completed this week. I spoke with participating households, and Thursday from 5:00 to 7:00 p.m. is the only pickup window that works for them. Also, intake materials need to be available in English, Spanish, and Somali — we're currently missing Somali. I haven't yet updated the operations sheet with these findings, so I wanted to make sure everyone here has this information as we review the plan.
